license_required.quote: An applicant for a license to practice professional nursing shall submit to the board evidence in such form as the board may prescribe

issuing_authority.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall establish an Alternative to Discipline Program for board licensees

name.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall establish an Alternative to Discipline Program for board licensees

type.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall have the following powers and duties

umbrella_agency.value: Division of Consumer Affairs, Department of Law and Public Safety
umbrella_agency.quote: the administrator of this compact shall be the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs in the Department of Law and Public Safety

age_minimum.quote: has attained his or her eighteenth birthday

moral_character_required.quote: is of good moral character, is not a habitual user of drugs and has never been convicted

degree_required.value: Diploma from accredited school of professional nursing
degree_required.quote: has completed a course of professional nursing study in an accredited school of professional nursing as defined by the board and holds a diploma therefrom

accrediting_body.quote: an accredited school of professional nursing shall admit as students only persons possessing the preliminary educational requirements set forth in section four hereof, shall abide by and conform to the curriculum and standards of operation prescribed from time to time by the board

exams.name: NCLEX-RN
exams.notes: Written examination in subjects determined by the board; may be supplemented by oral or practical examination
exams.quote: The applicant shall be required to pass a written examination in such subjects as the board may determine, which examination may be supplemented by an oral or practical examination or both.

exams.name: NCLEX-PN
exams.notes: For practical nursing licensure by examination
exams.quote: Has successfully passed an NCLEX-RN or NCLEX-PN Examination or recognized predecessor, as applicable

interval_years.quote: the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse, as a condition of biennial license renewal

required.quote: the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse, as a condition of biennial license renewal

period_years.quote: as a condition of biennial license renewal

value: one credit on prescription opioid drugs, including alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion
one credit on explicit and implicit bias for nurses providing perinatal treatment and care
organ and tissue donation and recovery instruction as condition of relicensure
topical_requirements.quote: include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning prescription opioid drugs, including alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion

available.quote: The board may issue a license to practice professional nursing without examination to an applicant who has been duly licensed or registered as a registered or professional nurse by examination or by original waiver under the laws of another State

requirements.value: Applicant must have been duly licensed in another state, territory, possession, DC, or foreign country, and in the opinion of the board must have qualifications equivalent to those required in NJ.
requirements.quote: if in the opinion of the board the applicant has the qualifications required by this act for the licensing of professional nurses, or equivalent qualifications

regulatory_model.quote: An applicant for a license to practice professional nursing shall submit to the board evidence in such form as the board may prescribe

credential_type.quote: Upon successfully passing such examinations the applicant shall be licensed by the board to practice professional nursing.

is_mandatory.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice professional nursing under this act shall during the effective period of such license be entitled to use the title "Registered Nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N."

title_protection.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice professional nursing under this act shall during the effective period of such license be entitled to use the title "Registered Nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N."

scope_protection.quote: Violations of nurse licensure and other laws relating to the practice of nursing may result in injury or harm to the public

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disciplinary action against an advanced practice nurse who violates the provisions of the act or any regulation promulgated thereunder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: To take disciplinary action, in accordance with P.L.1978, c.73 (C.45:1-14 et seq.) against an advanced practice nurse who violates the provisions of this act, any regulation promulgated thereunder, or P.L.1978, c.73 (C.45:1-14 et seq.)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Noncompliance by a licensee with the conditions for participation in the Alternative to Discipline Program
disciplinary_grounds.quote: require the program to immediately disclose to the committee the identity of a participating licensee in the event of noncompliance by the licensee with the conditions for participation or any other change in circumstances that may render the licensee inappropriate for participation in the program

disciplinary_grounds.description: A nurse under suspension, probation, or in an alternative program who practices in another party state without prior authorization
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The board may revoke the State license of a nurse under suspension, probation or participation who practices nursing in another party state without prior authorization from that state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Adverse action taken by a remote party state against a nurse's multistate licensure privilege
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The multistate licensure privilege granted by this State pursuant to the compact is subject to revocation or other disciplinary action as the result of any disciplinary action imposed by a nurse's home state.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or guilty finding for a felony offense under applicable state or federal criminal law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has not been convicted or found guilty, or has entered into an agreed disposition, of a felony offense under applicable state or federal criminal law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction or guilty finding for a misdemeanor offense related to the practice of nursing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has not been convicted or found guilty, or has entered into an agreed disposition, of a misdemeanor offense related to the practice of nursing as determined on a case-by-case basis

definition_quote.value: State practice laws means those individual party state's laws and regulations that govern the practice of nursing, define the scope of nursing practice, and create the methods and grounds for disciplining nurses.
definition_quote.quote: "State practice laws" means those individual party state's laws and regulations that govern the practice of nursing, define the scope of nursing practice, and create the methods and grounds for disciplining nurses.

value: diagnose and manage deviations from wellness and long-term illnesses
initiate laboratory and other diagnostic tests
prescribe or order medications and devices
prescribe or order treatments including referrals
methods_authorized.quote: an advanced practice nurse may manage preventive care services and diagnose and manage deviations from wellness and long-term illnesses, consistent with the needs of the patient and within the scope of practice of the advanced practice nurse, by: (1) initiating laboratory and other diagnostic tests; (2) prescribing or ordering medications and devices; and (3) prescribing or ordering treatments, including referrals to other licensed health care professionals, and performing specific procedures

drug_authority.value: Advanced practice nurses may prescribe or order medications and devices in inpatient and outpatient settings pursuant to joint protocols with a collaborating physician; may also dispense narcotic drugs for maintenance or detoxification treatment if training and registration requirements are met.
drug_authority.quote: an advanced practice nurse may dispense narcotic drugs for maintenance treatment or detoxification treatment if the advanced practice nurse has met the training and registration requirements set forth in subsection (g) of 21 U.S.C. s.823.

license_tiers.quote: Any person who holds a license to practice professional nursing under this act shall during the effective period of such license be entitled to use the title "Registered Nurse" and the abbreviation "R.N."

collaborative_practice_agreement_require.quote: the prescription is written in accordance with standing orders or joint protocols developed in agreement between a collaborating physician and the advanced practice nurse, or pursuant to the specific direction of a physician

full_independent_practice_available.quote: the physician is present or readily available through electronic communications

prescriptive_authority_certificate_requi.quote: the advanced practice nurse writes the prescription on a New Jersey Prescription Blank pursuant to P.L.2003, c.280 (C.45:14-40 et seq.), signs the nurse's own name to the prescription and prints the nurse's name and certification number

opioid_prescribing_limits.value: APRNs must complete six contact hours of continuing professional education in pharmacology related to controlled substances, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids, and risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion before ordering or prescribing controlled dangerous substances.
opioid_prescribing_limits.quote: the advanced practice nurse has completed six contact hours of continuing professional education in pharmacology related to controlled substances, including pharmacologic therapy, addiction prevention and management, and issues concerning prescription opioid drugs, including responsible prescribing practices, alternatives to opioids for managing and treating pain, and the risks and signs of opioid abuse, addiction, and diversion

nurse_licensure_compact_member.quote: The State of New Jersey enacts and enters into the Nurse Licensure Compact with all other jurisdictions that legally join in the compact

multistate_license_option_available.quote: "Single-state license" means a nurse license issued by a party state that authorizes practice only within the issuing state and does not include a multistate licensure privilege to practice in any other party state.

impaired_nurse_alternative_program_avail.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall establish an Alternative to Discipline Program for board licensees who are suffering from a chemical dependency or other impairment.

rn_death_pronouncement_authorized.quote: An attending advanced practice nurse may determine and certify the cause of death of the nurse's patient and execute the death certification pursuant to R.S.26:6-8 if no collaborating physician is available to do so and the nurse is the patient's primary caregiver.

aprn_formulary_or_protocol_required.quote: The joint protocols employed pursuant to subsections b. and c. of this section shall conform with standards adopted by the Director of the Division of Consumer Affairs

implicit_bias_training_required_in_curri.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall require that the number of credits of continuing education required of each person licensed as a professional nurse or a practical nurse who provides perinatal treatment and care to pregnant persons, as a condition of biennial license renewal, include one credit of educational programs or topics concerning explicit and implicit bias

military_education_credit_required.quote: The New Jersey Board of Nursing shall encourage schools of nursing approved by the board to consider granting a nursing student, who served in the United States military, academic credit toward the student's nursing degree
